rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something meets stated requirements, rules, or specifications.

example.english: This report needs to conform to the company's safety requirements.
example.traditional: 呢份報告要符合公司嘅安全要求。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 fu4 hap6 gung1 si1 ge3 on1 cyun4 jiu1 kau4

rows.note: Use this when someone actively adjusts their behavior, thoughts, or actions to fit something else.

example.english: Everyone has to conform to the new arrangements and get to work on time.
example.traditional: 大家都要配合新安排，準時返工。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 pui3 hap6 san1 on1 paai4 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this more formal word when conforming to a prevailing trend, situation, or social expectation rather than simply meeting a specification.

example.english: The company must conform to changes in the market to keep developing.
example.traditional: 公司要順應市場嘅轉變，先可以繼續發展。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jiu3 seon6 jing3 si5 coeng4 ge3 zyun2 bin3 sin1 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 faat3 zin2
